title: A feedback row joins the latest lookup that printed its pack handle before the report, not the earliest
goal: join_feedback maps a pack handle to the latest lookup that printed it no later than the feedback row's time (today handles.setdefault keeps the first session's group, ql_distill.py join_feedback), so a report on a handle looked up in two sessions joins the one it followed; querylog.md's exact-join wording names that rule; a test plants the two-session case (handle in s1 at 08:00 and s2 at 09:00, report at 09:05 joins s2).
